    Summarise propagule pressure

    Source: R/inv-introduction.R
    inv_propagule_pressure.Rd

    Propagule pressure combines the number of introduction events (propagule number) and the number of individuals released per event (propagule size). inv_propagule_pressure() summarises both for each group, optionally discounting older events with an exponential decay so that recent introductions weigh more.

    Usage

    inv_propagule_pressure(
  .data,
  size = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  decay = NULL,
  .by = NULL
)

    Arguments

    .data

    A data frame (or inv_pathway() table) with one row per introduction event.

    size

    <tidy-select> Column with the number of individuals introduced per event. Defaults to the size column of an <inv_pathway> table.

    time

    <tidy-select> Optional column with the event time, used with decay.

    decay

    Optional non-negative decay rate per time unit. When given, the column pp_discounted holds sum(size * exp(-decay * (t_max - t))).

    .by

    <tidy-select> Optional grouping columns. Grouped data frames are also respected.

    Value

    A tibble with one row per group and columns n_events (propagule number), total_propagules, mean_size, median_size, cv_size (coefficient of variation of size), max_size, pp_index (log10(1 + total_propagules)) and, when decay is set, pp_discounted.

    References

    Lockwood, J. L., Cassey, P. and Blackburn, T. (2005). The role of propagule pressure in explaining species invasions. Trends in Ecology and Evolution, 20, 223-228. doi:10.1016/j.tree.2005.02.004

    Examples

    inv_propagule_pressure(inv_introductions, size = propagule_size, .by = pathway)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 8
#>   pathway     n_events total_propagules mean_size median_size cv_size max_size
#>   <chr>          <int>            <dbl>     <dbl>       <dbl>   <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 stowaway          59              331      5.61         4     0.864       23
#> 2 escape            55              867     15.8         10     1.08        78
#> 3 corridor          23              269     11.7          9     0.861       35
#> 4 release           43             1774     41.3         35     0.771      123
#> 5 contaminant       36              244      6.78         4.5   0.907       25
#> 6 unaided           24              103      4.29         2.5   1.07        21
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: pp_index <dbl>

# Discount older introductions by 10% per year
inv_propagule_pressure(inv_introductions, size = propagule_size,
  time = year, decay = 0.1, .by = species)
